//: Seed rules for the governance store — read once when the store has no rules; after that the rows in storage are the policy (edit them, not this file).
Deny is the only access effect in use: a tool that is not offered cannot be called, and the model never has to be told not to.

pre.agent-render-needs-approval is the hybrid-mode default from STRATEGY Phase 4: an autonomous render asks a human first. To run fully autonomous, disable this rule in the store (or set NUNCIO_GOVERNANCE=off to bypass the whole plane in an emergency).

post rules key on the caller's class the way the demo keys on clearance: anonymous callers get contact redaction because whether scraped PII should flow out IS a question about who is asking; the injection sweep applies to everyone because whether text is addressed to the model is not a question about anyone's authority.
Every seeded rule has a case it must fire on in src/lib/governance/*.test.ts — a rule that matches nothing is indistinguishable from a rule that permits.

rules.description: Anonymous callers never see or call the agent surface. agent-auth already rejects them at the route; this keeps the tool out of any tool listing an anonymous caller is shown and audits attempts.
rules.reason: This surface requires an agent credential.

rules.description: Anonymous MCP callers are offered the free wedge only. Forward-looking: any future mcp.* tool other than research_and_draft is hidden from anonymous subjects until a rule says otherwise.
rules.reason: Anonymous callers may use the free research_and_draft tool only.

rules.description: Do not research prospects on denylisted domains (NUNCIO_BLOCKED_DOMAINS, comma-separated hosts) — e.g. our own properties or regulated verticals. Empty list = the rule matches nothing.
rules.reason: DENIED: this prospect URL is on a domain nuncio does not research. Do not retry.

rules.description: Same denylist for the autonomous agent's two entry points.
rules.reason: DENIED: this prospect URL is on a domain nuncio does not research. Do not retry.

rules.description: Hybrid mode is the default: the autonomous agent's render step asks a human before spending render credits. The denial is a routing slip — it names the approval endpoint and the retry header; the model/prompt is never involved.
rules.reason: APPROVAL REQUIRED: autonomous render is gated. POST /api/agent/approvals with this run's context, wait for a grant, then retry with the x-nuncio-approval-grant header.

rules.description: Money movement is a human call: the agent may propose a checkout, a person approves sending the payment link. Same hybrid-mode default as renders — disable via scripts/governance.ts to go fully autonomous.
rules.reason: APPROVAL REQUIRED: payment links are human-approved. POST /api/agent/approvals, wait for a grant, then retry with the x-nuncio-approval-grant header.

rules.description: Prospect-controlled text is untrusted input: strip text addressed to the model before it reaches synthesis or comes back out. Applies to every caller — whether text is trying to give the model orders is not a question about authority.
Free-tier output must not launder scraped contact PII to anonymous callers. Authenticated members and the agent surface see the record whole.

The live twin's prompt assembles owner playbook fields and agent-written handoff context — the latter carries prospect-adjacent text. Sweep both for injection directives before they become system-prompt content.
Same contact-PII boundary for the unauthenticated lite funnel endpoint — an anonymous caller gets the draft and the talking points, not the scraped mailbox.
